crossRefs.note: Jacob awakened out of his sleep, and he said, “Surely Yahweh is in this place, and I didn’t know it.”
Jacob called the name of the place Peniel; for he said, “I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.”
God said moreover to Moses, “You shall tell the children of Israel this, ‘Yahweh, the God of your fathers, the God of…
Your name, Yahweh, endures forever; your renown, Yahweh, throughout all generations.
“I am Yahweh. That is my name. I will not give my glory to another, nor my praise to engraved images.

translations.web: even Yahweh, the God of Armies; Yahweh is his name of renown!
translations.bsb: the LORD God of Hosts, the LORD is His name of renown.
translations.kjv: Even the LORD God of hosts; the LORD is his memorial.
translations.asv: even Jehovah, the God of hosts; Jehovah is his memorial name.
